text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali gives instructions to realise decisions announced at last week's ninth commemoration of his succeeding former president Habib Bourguiba. Ben Ali announced then that the average money market rate would be cut by one point, and the premium for coverage of foreign extchange by two points on credit for investment.
- Good performance in industrial production for first nine months of 1996.
- Tunisia astonished by the European agreement to set up rapid intervention force for southern Mediterranean region.
- Tunisia to make known its agriculture strategy at Rome FAO food summit.
